notes: Cells derived from BW27785 carrying Clostridium botulinum Rho (Cb-Rho); blue colonies = prion-containing, pale = prion-lacking. Same genotype in all samples, difference is the prion state. Labelled heterologous_expression (Cb-Rho in E. coli, per summary); expression construct and inducer not described, so inducer_added left out. is_control left out: pale cells are the comparator but not a reference genotype. Phase from 'Log-phase cultures' (stated) although grown 5 h from a colony. strain_group K-12 inferred from parent BW27785.

growth_phase.q: Log-phase cultures (LB broth, Miller formulation) inoculated with either blue or pale colonies were grown for 5 hr at 37 degrees celsius.

growth_temperature.q: were grown for 5 hr at 37 degrees celsius
